formats.title: One Month Of Slow Travel
formats.text: Two or three bases, no rushing. Combine a bay, the highlands and a national park, with time to sit still in between.

formats.title: A Season In Madagascar
formats.text: Settle in one region, work remotely or volunteer, and take guided trips on weekends. We arrange housing, transport and local contacts.
points: One home base with reliable internet

formats.title: Live Here, Fully Supported
formats.text: For researchers, artists, families and retirees. We handle housing and paperwork, then stay close for the whole stay.
points: A named contact for your whole stay

weeks.text: Arrive, settle in, explore the capital and the royal hill of Ambohimanga.
Work from the bay and sail the emerald coast.
Cocoa plantations, markets and northern wildlife.
Close the month on the islands of Nosy Iranja and Nosy Lonjo.

services.title: Local contacts
services.text: Guides, doctors, teachers and community projects.

quote: We came for three weeks and stayed for three months. Everything was ready when we landed.
manText1: Two weeks show you the postcard. A month lets you learn the market days, the roads and the names of your neighbours. We build the base so you can spend your time on the island, not on logistics.
manText2: Housing, transport, connectivity and local introductions are ready before you land.
weeksText: One way to spend four weeks. Scroll to explore. We adapt it to you.
finalTitle: Tell Us How Long You Want To Stay.
finalText: Share your dates and plans. A travel expert replies within one working day.
